greeting:
Hi, my name is Oskar and I am a computer science student at the University of Economics in Katowice, specializing in programming and algorithms. My main interests lie in artificial intelligence and image processing. I lead a student research group focused on these areas, where we work on research projects and develop practical AI skills.

I already have initial experience presenting at scientific conferences and writing academic articles. Currently, I am doing an internship at edge.ai, a company that implements AI-based solutions, particularly in the field of image processing for business clients.

Outside of university, I also develop my soft skills, for example through weekend work that has helped me improve my organization, teamwork, and interpersonal communication. In my free time, I enjoy reading science fiction and fantasy, playing board games and visiting theatres.
